ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (29) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Matthew 6:19–21 is translated from Tolstoy's Russian, not from an English Bible: «собирайте» (sobirayte) is 'gather' and «подкапывают» (podkapyvayut) 'dig under'. In Chrysostom, «сребролюбие» (srebrolyubie, literally 'love of silver') is 'love of money', «господь» (gospod') is 'the Lord', and «по образцу своему» (po obraztsu svoyemu) is 'after his own pattern', kept distinct from «образ» (obraz, 'image').
